test: approve on backend A, start on B through TLS Nginx, SIGKILL B, recover DDS card and command on A
environment: disposable local Compose project; PostgreSQL 16; two backend processes; TLS Nginx with consistent hash; generated loopback self-signed TLS certificate; synthetic trainee/instructor/group/submission/session
scope_limits: The test validates a completed student-scenario publish/start path, process crash after session start, fencing/lease takeover, checkpoint recovery, and durable station command on the survivor through Nginx. It does not inject a failure during the publication transaction, run 20/100 concurrent users during failure, or represent target hardware.
